title: Climate
description: The year as the city lives it (M2.10 step 3, D130–D133): snow days and the cold by month, the gas bill, what snow does to a walk and a bus, the holidays, and the clocks changing. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

snowDays.description: Days with an inch of snow or more, in hundredths, January to December.

degreeDays.description: Heating degree days (base 65°F), January to December: how much a month's cold asks of the furnace.

gas.description: The flat's gas bill (D130), due with the rent for the month just past.

fixed.description: In cents: the month's customer charge.

perCcf.description: In cents: a hundred cubic feet of gas, delivery and supply.

heating.description: Hundred cubic feet a year for heat, shared out by the months' degree days.

base.description: Hundred cubic feet a month for hot water and the stove.

snow.description: What a snow day does, that day and the morning after, until noon (D131).

pace.description: A walk's minutes, in hundredths of a clear day's.

late.description: Minutes a bus comes after its time.

holidays.description: Days the court and the college close and the buses run Sunday's timetable (D132). A fixed date that falls on a Saturday is kept the Friday before, on a Sunday the Monday after.

weekday.description: With nth, a weekday of the month.

nth.description: Which of the month's weekdays: 1 the first, -1 the last.

clocks.description: The clocks changing (D133): forward an hour on one Sunday's night, back on another's.

hour.description: The hour on the clock when it changes.

rest.description: Percent of rest an hour's sleep is worth, lost or gained.
